entities.name: Stuffy Doll
entities.description: A burlap-and-cotton doll that has survived countless battles and torments, wonders whether it was made to suffer, and now follows a nomad shaman.

entities.name: Nomad shaman
entities.description: A mighty nomad shaman, a contender in an epic struggle for power, who carries the doll and battles a famous crusader.

entities.name: Crusader
entities.description: A famous knight with a silver helm who leads a legion and is oblivious to the approaching meteor.

entities.name: Evil toymaker
entities.description: A toymaker who bought the doll from bandits and was arrested by villagers after his stuffed-bear minion was incinerated.

entities.name: Stuffed bear
entities.description: A stuffed minion possessed by the spirit of a murdered man, incinerated in its first battle with villagers.

entities.name: Slaughter of the Arches
entities.description: A rain-soaked battle in which the doll was pierced by a golden blade and questioned its purpose.

entities.name: Meteor
entities.description: A red dot in the night sky growing larger, a meteor that is about to end the battle.

events.summary: During the Slaughter of the Arches, the doll is pierced in the belly by a golden blade and wonders whether it was made to suffer.
events.quote: a golden blade pierced my belly.

events.summary: The doll seeks answers from mages, monks and philosophers, none of whom help except to try to use it.
events.quote: None had answers for a doll in the midst of an existential crisis

events.summary: The doll is kidnapped by bandits and sold to an evil toymaker, whose stuffed-bear minion dies in battle with villagers, leaving the doll on the street.
events.quote: I was kidnapped by bandits and sold to an evil toymaker.

events.summary: A nomad caravan seizes the doll from the roadside and puts it in a shaman's pack.
events.quote: As I was plucked from the roadside and shoved into a shaman's pack

events.summary: The doll, now a follower of the nomad shaman, watches her battle a legion of knights and a famous crusader while a meteor approaches.
events.quote: Tonight, we're locked in battle with a legion of knights, as she pits herself against a famous crusader.

events.summary: The doll accepts its fate as the meteor bears down and the battle is about to be over for the crusader.

relations.quote: Today, I'm the follower of a mighty nomad shaman.

relations.note: She pits herself against the famous crusader.
relations.quote: as she pits herself against a famous crusader.

relations.note: The toymaker had the stuffed bear as his minion.
relations.quote: He had a stuffed-bear minion who was possessed by the spirit of murdered man.
